metadata.source: Google Maps public search results and individual place pages
metadata.method: Searched village and multiple place categories in Google Maps; read visible result cards and 53 individual place pages. Parsed place-pin coordinates from the observed listing links. Excluded distant search results; kept two explicitly adjacent-village records separately. No API or phone verification.
limitations: Google Maps displayed a limited-view notice. This is not an exhaustive export of every place or every Google field.
Village administrative boundaries were not independently verified. Address locality conflicts are marked per record.
Public user-contributed names, categories, pins, phone numbers, ratings and opening times may be inaccurate or outdated.
Null means unavailable or not captured, not that the place has no such information.
Hours summaries are snapshots; weekly schedules were not collected. Do not treat them as permanent schedules.
Website values are links listed on Google Maps, not independently verified official websites.
Potential duplicates with distinct Google place IDs are retained and flagged.
metadata.phone_format: International string with leading +, where published; null when unavailable
